canonical.title: London IT conferences & tech events to bolt onto a weekend

parent.title: A London weekend around a Michelin dinner (May–June 2026)

siblings.title: Things to do in London
siblings.summary: What to do with the rest of a London weekend once dinner is booked — sights worth your time, current exhibitions, June events, day trips, and where to drink.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in London
siblings.summary: All six 3-star and sixteen 2-star Michelin restaurants in London for the 2026 guide, with a pick-by-scenario guide for anchoring a weekend trip.

sources.title: PyData London 2026
sources.claim: PyData London 2026 runs Fri-Sun Jun 5-7 at Convene Sancroft, St Paul's, with tutorials Friday and talks Saturday-Sunday — the only major weekend-spanning tech conference in the June run.

sources.title: London Tech Week 2026
sources.claim: London Tech Week 2026 runs Jun 8-12 with expo and content stages Jun 8-10 at Olympia London and a fringe-event programme spanning the city through Jun 12.

sources.title: LDX3 LeadDev London
sources.claim: LDX3 LeadDev London 2026 runs Jun 2-3 at the InterContinental London – The O2 for 2,500+ engineering leaders, with three main stages plus a Director+ track.

sources.title: Infosecurity Europe
sources.claim: Infosecurity Europe 2026 runs Jun 2-4 at ExCeL London with a new startup-awards programme added for 2026.

sources.title: Infosecurity Europe at ExCeL
sources.claim: Infosecurity Europe at ExCeL London opens 09:30 each day, closing 17:30 on Jun 2-3 and 16:00 on Jun 4.

sources.title: The AI Summit London 2026
sources.claim: The AI Summit London 2026 runs Jun 10-11 at Tobacco Dock with 10+ stages, 5,000+ attendees and 300+ speakers under London Tech Week's umbrella.

sources.title: AI Summit passes & pricing
sources.claim: AI Summit London passes range from a £149 Tobacco Dock Campus Pass (limited-time) up to £2,699 for the VisionAIres VIP Pass.

sources.title: Africa Tech Summit London
sources.claim: Africa Tech Summit London's 10th edition lands May 29, 2026 at the London Stock Exchange with 350+ investors, founders and corporates plus an investment showcase featuring 13 selected ventures.

sources.title: DevOpsCon London
sources.claim: DevOpsCon London 2026 runs May 11-15 with the main expo May 12-13.

sources.title: Big Data LDN
sources.claim: Big Data LDN 2026 runs Sep 23-24 at Olympia London — free to attend, 15 conference theatres, Snowflake/Databricks/Google Cloud and start-ups exhibiting.

sources.title: React Advanced London
sources.claim: React Advanced London 2026 runs Oct 23 & 26 at The Brewery (52 Chiswell Street, EC1Y 4SD), hybrid format with day-1 in-person and day-2 plus workshops online.

sources.title: Hardware Pioneers Max
sources.claim: Hardware Pioneers Max 2026 takes 6,000 engineers and 250+ exhibitors to ExCeL London on Jun 10-11 — the UK's flagship hardware/IoT show.

sources.title: AI Native DevCon '26
sources.claim: AI Native DevCon London 2026 runs Jun 1-2 at The Brewery (Barbican) for VPs of engineering, CTOs, platform owners and senior engineers running AI agents in production.

sources.title: LTW Hackathon
sources.claim: London Tech Week's official hackathon is a one-day innovation sprint on Wed Jun 10 at the ICC, bringing students, developers and founders together on national-challenge prototypes.

sources.title: LTW Fringe programme
sources.claim: The London Tech Week fringe programme runs Jun 8-12 with the majority of events free to attend — drinks receptions, VC pitch sessions, sector roundtables hosted by external partners across the city.

sources.title: London Node.js User Group
sources.claim: London Node.js User Group (LNUG) has run monthly meetups since September 2011 on the 4th Wednesday of each month, except December.

sources.title: London.js
sources.claim: London.js absorbed the dormant React London User Group and now runs the city's main monthly JavaScript meetup covering React, vanilla JS and frontend tooling.

sources.title: AI Tinkerers London
sources.claim: AI Tinkerers London runs monthly ~3-hour demo nights for AI builders — live working prototypes, technical Q&A, members from OpenAI, Google, Meta, Anthropic, Vercel.

sources.title: Silicon Roundabout
sources.claim: Silicon Roundabout bills itself as the UK's biggest deep-tech meetup, running a fortnightly Tuesday networking event aimed at founders, developers and investors.

sources.title: dev.events London IT
sources.claim: dev.events tracks 62+ London IT conferences for 2026, including a December double-bill of The Principal Dev (Dec 3-4) and Clean Architecture Masterclass (Dec 10-11).

sources.title: Quantum Insider — LTW partners
sources.claim: Microsoft and AWS are headline partners for London Tech Week 2026, joined by Deloitte, Accenture, HSBC, Salesforce and ServiceNow.

sources.title: TechCabal — Africa Tech Summit
sources.claim: The 2026 Africa Tech Summit London covers fintech, AI, IPOs, climate tech, digital infrastructure, investment and cross-border trade — its 10th edition.

sources.title: Luminous PR — must-attend list
sources.claim: Industry roundups consistently call out London Tech Week, Infosecurity Europe and Big Data LDN as the three must-attend London tech events for the 2026 calendar.

sources.title: AI Native DevCon
sources.claim: AI Native DevCon — Tessl's developer conference for AI-native engineering.

sources.title: The Principal Dev
sources.claim: The Principal Dev runs masterclasses for tech leads.

sources.title: Clean Architecture Masterclass
